Turn 1: Fold Calculus

Fold Calculus is a new formal system. It treats a signal as a sequence of folds (local crests and troughs) and differentiates the migration of those folds, not the slope of a continuum. Ordinary calculus is recovered only in a dense-fold limit.

Objects. A fold trace is a finite or countable sequence of events

F=((tk,ak,σk))k∈ZF = \bigl( (t_k, a_k, \sigma_k) \bigr)_{k \in \mathbb{Z}}F=((tk​,ak​,σk​))k∈Z​

where tkt_ktk​ is strictly increasing time, ak>0a_k > 0ak​>0 is amplitude, and σk∈{+1,−1}\sigma_k \in \{+1, -1\}σk​∈{+1,−1} is the sign (crest or trough). Consecutive signs must alternate. The gap and log-amplitude are

δk=tk−tk−1,λk=ln⁡ak.\delta_k = t_k - t_{k-1}, \qquad \lambda_k = \ln a_k.δk​=tk​−tk−1​,λk​=lnak​.

The state at fold kkk is the pair (δk,λk)(\delta_k, \lambda_k)(δk​,λk​). Smooth functions are not primitive: a smooth curve enters the theory only after it has been folded (keep its local extrema, discard the arcs between them).

The fold derivative. The forward fold derivative at kkk is

DΦFk=(δk+1−δkδk,  λk+1−λkδk).D_\Phi F_k = \left( \frac{\delta_{k+1} - \delta_k}{\delta_k},\; \frac{\lambda_{k+1} - \lambda_k}{\delta_k} \right).DΦ​Fk​=(δk​δk+1​−δk​​,δk​λk+1​−λk​​).

The first component is the relative stretch of the gap (DΦδD_\Phi^\deltaDΦδ​); the second is the amplitude drift per unit gap (DΦλD_\Phi^\lambdaDΦλ​).

Two traces are fold-equivalent when their gap and amplitude sequences coincide, regardless of an overall time shift. DΦD_\PhiDΦ​ is invariant under that shift, and under a global rescaling of amplitude it changes only by a constant in λ\lambdaλ, which the difference removes.

The fold integral. Given a seed gap δ0\delta_0δ0​ and seed log-amplitude λ0\lambda_0λ0​, and a pair of rates (sk,rk)(s_k, r_k)(sk​,rk​):

δk+1=δk(1+sk),λk+1=λk+rkδk,\delta_{k+1} = \delta_k (1 + s_k), \qquad \lambda_{k+1} = \lambda_k + r_k \delta_k,δk+1​=δk​(1+sk​),λk+1​=λk​+rk​δk​,

provided sk>−1s_k > -1sk​>−1 so gaps stay positive. The fold integral from 000 to nnn is the trace rebuilt this way:

∫Φ(s,r)=F.\int_\Phi (s, r) = F.∫Φ​(s,r)=F.

Fundamental theorem. By construction,

DΦ∫Φ(s,r)=(s,r),∫ΦDΦFD_\Phi \int_\Phi (s, r) = (s, r), \qquad \int_\Phi D_\Phi FDΦ​∫Φ​(s,r)=(s,r),∫Φ​DΦ​F

reproduces FFF up to the seed (δ0,λ0)(\delta_0, \lambda_0)(δ0​,λ0​). The two operators are inverses on the space of alternating fold traces. There is no remainder term, because nothing between folds is stored.

Rules.

  • Product of traces: gap-wise addition of log-amplitudes and a convex mix of gaps with weights w,1−w∈(0,1)w, 1-w \in (0,1)w,1−w∈(0,1):
δ(FG)=w δ(F)+(1−w) δ(G),λ(FG)=λ(F)+λ(G).\delta(FG) = w\,\delta(F) + (1-w)\,\delta(G), \qquad \lambda(FG) = \lambda(F) + \lambda(G).δ(FG)=wδ(F)+(1−w)δ(G),λ(FG)=λ(F)+λ(G).

Then DΦλ(FG)=DΦλF+DΦλGD_\Phi^\lambda(FG) = D_\Phi^\lambda F + D_\Phi^\lambda GDΦλ​(FG)=DΦλ​F+DΦλ​G, while the stretch part is the same convex mix of stretches, not a Leibniz rule. Addition of amplitudes is not an operation of the theory: folds add in the log.

  • Chain rule for an order-preserving reparametrization uk=ϕ(tk)u_k = \phi(t_k)uk​=ϕ(tk​): DΦλ(F∘ϕ)=DΦλFϕ-gap ratioD_\Phi^\lambda (F \circ \phi) = \dfrac{D_\Phi^\lambda F}{\phi\text{-gap ratio}}DΦλ​(F∘ϕ)=ϕ-gap ratioDΦλ​F​. The stretch picks up a second term from the variation of ϕ\phiϕ's own gaps. Order-reversing maps are excluded (they would break alternation).

Worked example. Gaps 1,2,4,81, 2, 4, 81,2,4,8 and amplitudes 1,e,e3,e61, e, e^3, e^61,e,e3,e6:

DΦδ=(1,1,1),DΦλ=(1,1,0.375).D_\Phi^\delta = (1, 1, 1), \qquad D_\Phi^\lambda = (1, 1, 0.375).DΦδ​=(1,1,1),DΦλ​=(1,1,0.375).

The gaps double at every step, so relative stretch is constantly 111. Log-amplitude rises by 111, then 222, then 333, and dividing by the growing gap makes the drift fall. Integrating (1,1,0.375)(1, 1, 0.375)(1,1,0.375) from seed (δ0,λ0)=(1,0)(\delta_0, \lambda_0) = (1, 0)(δ0​,λ0​)=(1,0) returns the original trace exactly. Grok noted that a classical spline derivative through these points would give four different slopes depending on how the arcs are filled; Fold Calculus refuses that dependence.

Dense-fold limit. If gaps shrink uniformly, δk=ε\delta_k = \varepsilonδk​=ε, and λk=ln⁡∣f′(tk)∣\lambda_k = \ln|f'(t_k)|λk​=ln∣f′(tk​)∣ for a Morse function fff, then DΦλD_\Phi^\lambdaDΦλ​ tends to

ddtln⁡∣f′∣=f′′f′\frac{d}{dt}\ln|f'| = \frac{f''}{f'}dtd​ln∣f′∣=f′f′′​

at the extrema, and DΦδD_\Phi^\deltaDΦδ​ tends to 000. The stretch component has no classical counterpart.

Use cases. Event cameras, spike trains, peak-picked audio, and any record whose reliable marks are turning points. It does not compute the slope of a straight line that never folds: "A line with no extremum is the zero object of the theory."

Turn 2: Fold Calculus applied to coding (Self / Contain / Certain / Train)

Grok mapped the four folds to a coding loop: each act is a fold (tk,ak,σk)(t_k, a_k, \sigma_k)(tk​,ak​,σk​), with δk=tk−tk−1\delta_k = t_k - t_{k-1}δk​=tk​−tk−1​, λk=ln⁡ak\lambda_k = \ln a_kλk​=lnak​, and DΦFk=(sk,rk)D_\Phi F_k = (s_k, r_k)DΦ​Fk​=(sk​,rk​).

  • Self appends the finished act and refuses a repeated sign.
  • Contain checks the gap law sk>−1s_k > -1sk​>−1 and the bounds
    ∣sk∣≤Cs,∣rk∣≤Cr|s_k| \le C_s, \qquad |r_k| \le C_r∣sk​∣≤Cs​,∣rk​∣≤Cr​
    Out-of-bounds acts are quarantined as raw folds.
  • Certain(n) holds when the last nnn pairs (s,r)(s, r)(s,r) all passed Contain. Certainty is a count, not a probability.
  • Train integrates only a certain pair forward:
    δk+1=δk(1+sk),λk+1=λk+rkδk\delta_{k+1} = \delta_k (1 + s_k), \qquad \lambda_{k+1} = \lambda_k + r_k \delta_kδk+1​=δk​(1+sk​),λk+1​=λk​+rk​δk​
    and predicts the next fold: wait δk+1\delta_{k+1}δk+1​, spend mass eλk+1e^{\lambda_{k+1}}eλk+1​, flip the sign.

Permissions table: Self reads last act, may change the trace, may not change the container; Contain reads the new rate, may accept or quarantine, may not change trace history; Certain reads the accepted run, may change the certainty count, may not change the next act; Train reads a certain pair, may change the predicted next fold, may not change past folds.

Worked example: drifts 1,1,0.3751, 1, 0.3751,1,0.375 with Cs=Cr=1C_s = C_r = 1Cs​=Cr​=1: the first two rates pass and only watch; the third is the first fully certain step, and Train emits the next fold. A stretch of 555 never reaches Train.

Python module (verbatim):

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from math import exp, log

@dataclass
class Fold:
    t: float
    mass: float
    sign: int  # +1 crest, -1 trough

@dataclass
class Loop:
    Cs: float = 1.0
    Cr: float = 1.0
    need: int = 3
    folds: list = field(default_factory=list)
    held: list = field(default_factory=list)
    certain: int = 0

    def self(self, act: Fold) -> bool:
        if act.mass <= 0:
            return False
        if self.folds and act.sign == self.folds[-1].sign:
            return False
        if self.folds and act.t <= self.folds[-1].t:
            return False
        self.folds.append(act)
        return True

    def rates(self):
        f = self.folds
        if len(f) < 3:
            return None
        d0, d1 = f[-2].t - f[-3].t, f[-1].t - f[-2].t
        if d0 <= 0:
            return None
        s = (d1 - d0) / d0
        r = (log(f[-1].mass) - log(f[-2].mass)) / d0
        return s, r

    def contain(self, s: float, r: float) -> bool:
        return s > -1 and abs(s) <= self.Cs and abs(r) <= self.Cr

    def train(self):
        pair = self.rates()
        if pair is None:
            return {"state": "short"}
        s, r = pair
        if not self.contain(s, r):
            self.certain = 0
            self.held.append((s, r))
            return {"state": "quarantine", "s": s, "r": r}
        self.certain += 1
        if self.certain < self.need:
            return {"state": "watching", "certain": self.certain, "s": s, "r": r}
        last = self.folds[-1]
        gap = last.t - self.folds[-2].t
        return {
            "state": "predict",
            "t": last.t + gap * (1 + s),
            "mass": exp(log(last.mass) + r * gap),
            "sign": -last.sign,
            "s": s,
            "r": r,
        }
